title: Shock wavefronts for parabolic equations with sign-changing diffusivity
summary: We consider a reaction-diffusion equation in a one-dimensional space, where the diffusion coefficient changes sign from positive to negative and back to positive. The reaction term is bistable, with its interior zero located in the region where the diffusivity is negative. The model does not admit continuous wavefronts, i.e., continuous traveling waves that connect the steady states $0$ and $1$. We prove the existence of a family of shock wavefronts, that is, wavefronts with profiles exhibiting a jump discontinuity. We investigate the properties of these profiles and their propagation…
